description: Copy one file from the remote workspace into the LOCAL project directory (up to 64 MiB). An existing local file is only replaced with overwrite. Results show project-relative paths only.

context.description: Context name. Omit to use the default.

fleet.description: Fleet name. Omit to use the default.

local.description: Destination in the local project directory. Default: the file name.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing local file. Without it an existing file is an error.

workspace.description: Workspace id. Omit to use this session's workspace on the fleet.

name: download
